C1528.title: Police in Putian Recover Over 350,000 Yuan in Two Fraud Cases
C1528.summary: A resident in Xianyou County, Putian City, was lured by a stranger on Telegram with promises of high-yield fund investments and transferred 300,000 yuan to a designated account before the contact disappeared. Police quickly activated an emergency stop-payment mechanism and successfully recovered the defrauded funds for the victim.

references.title: City police successively crack two fraud cases involving over 350,000 yuan - Putian Net
